## Load Data

```{r}
#| label: packages-data

library(tidyverse)
library(moments)
library(caret)

data <- read_csv("data-train.csv")
```

## Transform Data

```{r}
#| label: transform

#making new variables for our summary stats

#mean = R_moment_1, C_moment_2 is variance, everything else is as commented
data <- data |>
  mutate(
    m1 = R_moment_1, m2 = R_moment_2, m3 = R_moment_3, m4 = R_moment_4,

    # central moments
    C_moment_2 = m2 - m1^2,                               # variance
    C_moment_3 = m3 - 3*m1*m2 + 2*m1^3,
    C_moment_4 = m4 - 4*m1*m3 + 6*m1^2*m2 - 3*m1^4,

    # standardized versions
    sd_R     = sqrt(C_moment_2),
    skewness = C_moment_3 / sd_R^3,
    kurtosis = C_moment_4 / sd_R^4,                       # raw kurtosis
    ex_kurt  = kurtosis - 3                               # excess kurtosis
  )

#using a categorical to address infinity
data <- data |>
  mutate(
    Fr = as.factor(Fr),
    Re = as.factor(Re)
  )
```


```{r}
#| label: train

set.seed(2026)
data_train <- data |>
  slice_sample(prop = 0.7)
data_test <- data |>
  anti_join(data_train)

train.model <- glm(R_moment_1 ~ St + Re + Fr, family = gaussian, data = data_train)


```
